title: Adjusted Spear Jabs
description: Increases the Spear's jab attack dps and removes its minimum range to make using it on its own more viable
body:
Minecraft Spears' jab attack (left click) is very underpowered. This datapack fixes that!

- Jab Attack minimum range has been removed!
- Damage Changes:
  - Wooden Spear:
    - 1 -> 2.5 Attack Damage
  - Stone Spear:
    - 2 -> 3.5 Attack Damage
    - 1.33 -> 1.44 Attack Speed
  - Copper Spear:
    - 2 -> 4 Attack Damage
    - 1.18 -> 1.26 Attack Speed
    - No Longer actively worse than the Stone Spear!
  - Iron Spear:
    - 3 -> 6 Attack Damage
  - Golden Spear:
    - 1 -> 4.5 Attack Damage
    - 1.05 -> 1.04 Attack Speed
  - Diamond Spear:
    - 4 -> 7 Attack Damage
  - Netherite Spear:
    - 5 -> 8 Attack Damage
    - 0.87 -> 0.92 Attack Speed

The changed spears in this version can be obtained by crafting them as normal or finding them in their ordinary locations in loot chests. Note that Vanilla Spears will still be found: in the Creative Mode inventory, when dropped by mobs, when using the crafting table to repair spears, when using /give (there are replacement /function commands for this if needed)
